title: Lost Mary BM600 P & B Cloudd Prefilled Vape Pods 20mg - 2PK
description: The P and B Cloudd Lost Mary BM600 Prefilled Pods recreate the sweet taste of candyfloss with a frosty edge. Sugary notes run through the inhale, while the cooling finish keeps the blend light and refreshing. Each pack includes two 2ml pods prefilled with 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid, delivering up to 600 puffs per pod depending on usage. Designed for a smooth mouth-to-lung (MTL) vape, they offer consistent flavour with no refills or coil changes. Compatible with the Lost Mary BM600 Prefilled Pod Kit, installation is quick and mess-free: click a pod into place and enjoy a sweet, icy vape.
